$comment: Audit item M5. The CLI ships zero runtime dependencies and will keep
shipping plain ESM JavaScript — TypeScript is a devDependency used as a
CHECKER, never as a build step. `noEmit` is the point: nothing is
compiled, nothing is published from here, and `src/` stays directly
runnable by node with no transpile in the path.
What this buys: the typos a test suite only catches when it happens to
execute the branch — a misspelt property on an index.json entry, a
helper called with the wrong arity, a function whose callers disagree
`strictNullChecks` is what makes that last claim true (change 0246): with
it off, null and undefined belong to every type and the checker cannot
see a caller that forgot one. `strict` and `noImplicitAny` stay off —
the source is JavaScript with JSDoc where it helps, not annotated
